items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...all the Scott Jopper music... [INTERVIEWEE] I keep it.

ctx.x: Yeah, the road. Oh, there's quite a few. Like a, a father came around here, what was his name, he used to write all the stuff for the Sunday South? You remember that? Yeah. And Walter Pichardt and Kildee, or Clyde Cardone, that's it. Manu Kruzman. That's for John and Brunas. Now do man, he used to do arranging to do the right. Well he used to do it. Yeah, well he used to do all that Dix-Land stuff. In fact I have Dix-Land stuff. I got some music. I have Dix-Land stuff. I got some music. I got it. I said I'm going…
Arrange with these this room. Oh yeah, all those old numbers, all the Scott Jopper music and all the music.
I keep it. Yeah. And I keep it. Yeah. And I keep it. Yeah. And I keep it. Yeah. And I keep it.
